The calendar window is Monday, October 26 to Thursday, December 31 [1]. Upcoming career/internship-related events listed:
• Becker Education — Mon, Nov 2, 2026 1 PM to 2 PM, ASB 220; hosted by Accounting Club. FREE. [2]

question: is there a club for people who like hiking or outdoors stuff

body.answer:
Yes. The club directory lists the Hiking Club (Student Organization): https://archway.ramapo.edu/Hiking/. Other outdoors-related options include RCNJ Birding, for birding and trips to observation spots: https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/rcnj-birding/. [6] The Ski and Snowboard Club organizes events and trips to ski areas: https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/ramapo-ski-snowboard-club/. question: is there an environmental club or anything sustainability related i can join?

body.answer:
No club in the directory has “environmental,” “join,” “related,” or “sustainability” in its name; these are the closest matches. [2–5]

1STEP (Student Organization): “Students Together for Environmental Progress”; it focuses on sustainability, environmental issues, and Ramapo Green. It offers guided nature walks, D-I-Ys, campus cleanups, and free clothing swaps/giveaways. To join, attend weekly meetings and events. Email 1step@ramapo.edu or follow @1step_rcnj. [3,10–11]

Other options: Garden Club (Student Organization), whose mission is sustainable gardening and community gardening/botany [2]; RCNJ Birding (Student Organization), for birds, ecology, and habitat conservation [4]; and Sunrise RCNJ (Student Organization), which works on climate change, greener policies, activism, and outreach. [5]

Ramapo Green also lists Enactus, Hiking Club, the SGA Sustainability Committee, and Sunrise RCNJ among sustainability-related groups. [6] The Committee promotes student engagement, connects clubs, creates interest groups, and develops sustainability leadership; sustainable organizations are encouraged to have a representative. [13,22] Ramapo Green’s directory entry is a Department. [18] Ramapo Green’s page offers a “Ramapo Green Archway” link: https://archway.ramapo.edu/Green/club_signup. [8]

The Accounting Club page doesn’t name its president or list a direct email for them. It gives the club email, accountclub@ramapo.edu; you could ask there to be connected with the president. [2] For help, contact the Center for Student Involvement at csi@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7593, SC-202. [2]

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/accounting-club/)

question: which club should i join if i want to make friends fast? im a shy transfer student

body.answer:
There’s no verified recommendation for which club will help you make friends fast; the pages don’t say how quickly clubs help members make friends. Transfer Connection looks relevant to your transfer experience: it aims to ease the transition and connect new transfer students, and says it is a great way to stay informed, use resources and get connected. [2]

The Center for Student Success says to follow @rcnjtransfers at https://www.instagram.com/rcnjtransfers/ for transfer updates, events and activities. To ask for more information, email Meghan Gregory, Assistant Director of New Student Experience, at mgregory@ramapo.edu. The Transfer Center & Veterans Lounge is in E211. [8][9]

The college advises finding something in common to start a conversation and choosing social activities that energize you. [5][6] All clubs listed on the clubs page are open to all students; joining can provide interesting friends. [10]

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/transfer-connection/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/health-promotion/wellness-dimensions/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/health-promotion/wellness-dimensions/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/transfer-connection/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/transfer-connection/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/)

question: how many people usually show up to the environmental club meetings, is it a big group

body.answer:
If you mean 1STEP (Students Together for Environmental Progress), it holds weekly meetings and events [6]. The published information doesn’t say how many people usually attend, so I can’t verify how large the group is. Ask 1STEP at 1step@ramapo.edu [6]. The Center for Student Involvement is also listed with questions: csi@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7593 [6].

Sources: [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/1step-students-together-environmental-progress/)
